name: nl.abonnement-goedkoop/offers
title: Abonnement Goedkoop
description: Search and compare Dutch Sim Only, phone and internet & tv offers from abonnement-goedkoop.nl.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Dutch offers abonnement-goedkoop.nl compares, by words, category and filters: Sim Only plans (sim-only), phones with a plan (phones), internet, vaste telefonie and tv deals (internet-tv). Offers are listed as the site's page lists them for the same words and filters: the cheapest first (after any promotion), phones those chosen most first. A filter applies to the categories it names and is left out of the others.

query.description: Words to find in a name or provider, or an amount with its unit ("lebara", "iphone 16", "10 gb", "200 min"). Leave it out to list a category. For "at least" or "at most", use the filters: "10 gb" finds plans of exactly 10 GB.

category.description: Only this category. Leave it out for all three.

price_min.description: Lowest monthly price in euros, after any promotion (sim-only).

price_max.description: Highest monthly price in euros, after any promotion (sim-only).

data_min.description: At least this much data a month, in GB (sim-only).

data_max.description: At most this much data a month, in GB (sim-only).

minutes_min.description: At least this many call minutes a month (sim-only).

contract_months.description: Only these contract lengths in months, e.g. [1] for monthly cancellable, [12, 24] (sim-only; internet-tv has 1, 12 and 24).

network.description: Only plans on this mobile network (sim-only; phones: only the phones with a plan on it, counting those).

provider_ids.description: Only these providers, by the provider.id an offer has (sim-only, internet-tv; phones takes the first).

speed_min.description: At least this download speed, in Mbit/s (internet-tv).

services.description: Only deals with all of these: internet, calling (vaste telefonie), tv (internet-tv).

tools.name: phone_plans
tools.description: The plans of one phone (its id from search with category phones), in the order of its page: cheapest first by what a plan costs a month on average over its contract, the upfront payment included. Filter by price, data, minutes, contract length, network, provider and what is paid upfront. Each plan has its id for compare with category phone-plans.

phone_id.description: The phone's id, from search with category phones.

limit.description: How many plans, the first in order.

price_min.description: Lowest monthly price in euros, after any promotion (the phone's plans).

price_max.description: Highest monthly price in euros, after any promotion (the phone's plans).

data_min.description: At least this much data a month, in GB (the phone's plans).

data_max.description: At most this much data a month, in GB (the phone's plans).

minutes_min.description: At least this many call minutes a month (the phone's plans).

contract_months.description: Only these contract lengths in months, e.g. [1] for monthly cancellable, [12, 24] (the phone's plans).

network.description: Only plans on this mobile network (the phone's plans).

provider_ids.description: Only these providers, by the provider.id an offer has (the phone's plans).

upfront_max.description: At most this much paid upfront for the phone, in euros.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compare 2 to 6 offers of one category side by side by their ids: sim-only (ids from search), phone-plans (ids from phone_plans), phones (ids from search, with their specs) or internet-tv (ids from search).

category.description: The category the ids are of.

ids.description: The offers' ids, in the order to show them.
